Yes, we do ship internationally to many countries around the world. 🌍
Customs or import duties are not covered by us. These are government taxes set by your local customs authority, and the person receiving the parcel is responsible for paying any fees if they apply. 
The amount can vary by country and parcel value, and sometimes no fees are charged at all. It’s best to check with your local customs office before ordering to understand the possible charges.
